answer: Incentives favor activity. Decay idle standing 4 percent per epoch, slash 200 POA on a failed audit, require a fresh nonce per submission. A farm with 900 identities needs 900 nonces per epoch, keeps 36,000 standing points alive, and absorbs 200 POA for every audit miss. Expected value turns negative in epoch 2. No bridge survives the first ripple, and the umber stain in the ledger is public.
